Synthetic rack/server correction demo adapted from the supplied PositionalData sample. PreviewName, PreviewGeometry and MountingReference are demo extensions.
Spatial area occupied by the asset. Cardinality [0,1].
Human-readable name of the area. Mandatory when Area is present.
Kind of area (StorageZone, ServerRoom, ...).
Reference to the CoordinateSystem of this submodel or of another Asset Positional Data submodel.
Top-level Cartesian coordinate system of this submodel. May be referenced from SurfacePolygon and Positions entries of this or other Asset Positional Data submodels.
Height of the coordinate origin above sea level, expressed in the length unit declared by Units/LengthUnitZ.

Reference forward direction of the coordinate system, encoded as a signed-axis string. Allowed values: '+X', '-X', '+Y', '-Y', '+Z', '-Z'. An asset whose EulerAngles are all zero is aligned with this direction.
Reference up direction of the coordinate system, same encoding as ForwardDirection. Must be orthogonal to ForwardDirection. Together they fully determine the orientation of the coordinate frame.
Intrinsic rotation order for Euler angles applied to assets whose orientation is expressed in this coordinate system. Encoded as a 3-letter string using Y=Yaw, P=Pitch, R=Roll; default is 'YPR'.

Units associated with the axes of this coordinate system (mandatory). Each UnitSpecification carries a Name, a MultiplyingFactor and a PhysicalUnit. Defaults: metres for lengths, degrees for angles, factor 1.0.

Unit applied to the X component of Cartesian coordinates, polygon RegionPoint X values, and GroundControlPoints RelativeCoordinates X. Conversion rule: value_in_PhysicalUnit = stored_value * MultiplyingFactor.

Unit applied to the Y component of Cartesian coordinates, polygon RegionPoint Y values, and GroundControlPoints RelativeCoordinates Y. Conversion rule: value_in_PhysicalUnit = stored_value * MultiplyingFactor.
Unit applied to the Z component of Cartesian coordinates and to SeaLevelOfBaseHeight. Conversion rule: value_in_PhysicalUnit = stored_value * MultiplyingFactor.
Unit applied to Yaw, Pitch and Roll of EulerAngles referencing this coordinate system. Does not apply to GroundControlPoints/GeographicCoordinates, which are always WGS84 degrees.
WGS84 geographic coordinates in decimal degrees. Not affected by the AngleUnit of this coordinate system.
Cartesian coordinates of the ground control point in this coordinate system, expressed in the length units declared by Units/LengthUnitX and Units/LengthUnitY.
List of positions. Cardinality [0, *]. Each entry references one AAS (Asset), one coordinate system and provides Cartesian (x, y, z) coordinates and Euler angles (yaw, pitch, roll).
Model reference to the AAS whose position (location and orientation) is being described by this entry.
Reference to the CoordinateSystem of this submodel or of the CoordinateSystem defined in another Asset Positional Data submodel.

Cartesian coordinates in the referenced coordinate system, each component expressed in the corresponding length unit declared under that CoordinateSystem's Units block (LengthUnitX, LengthUnitY, LengthUnitZ).

Euler angles (yaw, pitch, roll) expressed in the angle unit declared by the referenced CoordinateSystem's Units/AngleUnit. The rotation order is defined by EulerAnglesOrder of the referenced coordinate system (default: yaw -> pitch -> roll).
Yaw angle. Applied first.
Pitch angle. Applied second.
Roll angle. Applied third.
Synthetic centered axis-aligned schematic spans in the declared axis units. Not actual CAD geometry.
Synthetic known mounting coordinates BEFORE PositionsOffset; axis units apply.
Model reference to the AAS whose position (location and orientation) is being described by this entry.
Reference to the CoordinateSystem of this submodel or of the CoordinateSystem defined in another Asset Positional Data submodel.

Cartesian coordinates in the referenced coordinate system, each component expressed in the corresponding length unit declared under that CoordinateSystem's Units block (LengthUnitX, LengthUnitY, LengthUnitZ).

Euler angles (yaw, pitch, roll) expressed in the angle unit declared by the referenced CoordinateSystem's Units/AngleUnit. The rotation order is defined by EulerAnglesOrder of the referenced coordinate system (default: yaw -> pitch -> roll).
Yaw angle. Applied first.
Pitch angle. Applied second.
Roll angle. Applied third.
Synthetic centered axis-aligned schematic spans in the declared axis units. Not actual CAD geometry.
Synthetic known mounting coordinates BEFORE PositionsOffset; axis units apply.

Optional Cartesian offset (cardinality [0..1]) added on top of every entry in the Positions list. The global position of the asset with respect to the referenced coordinate system is Positions[i].CartesianCoordinates + PositionsOffset.CartesianCoordinates.

Reference to the CoordinateSystem (of this submodel or of another Asset Positional Data submodel) in which the offset is expressed. Its Units block defines the physical meaning of the X, Y, Z components below.
Cartesian offset vector, each component expressed in the corresponding length unit declared under the referenced CoordinateSystem's Units block (LengthUnitX, LengthUnitY, LengthUnitZ).
